title: Session 2026-11-02, six more data satellites, money-site links, paid rail staged
verdict: Every channel still shows zero verified human usage and $0 MCP revenue, so this session did not add another back-office server. It shipped six more free servers that know what a model cannot (2026 IRS limits, live certificate data, exact statistics, USDA nutrition, AP score tables), each feeding a money site that already earns. It also linked eight money sites back to their servers, cross-linked all 15 repos, opened three domain-list PRs and staged a real paid rail (Apify pay-per-event) that needs only the owner's token.
